record.question: He was charged with abetting the crime
record.explanation: Answer C: dissuading. The restored direction asks for an antonym. Abetting means helping or encouraging wrongdoing. “Dissuading” means discouraging the action; instigating and supporting point in the same direction as abetting. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/abet. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
record.direction: Directions (Question Nos. 56-70): Choose the correct antonyms of the underlined words:
record.questionMarkup: He was charged with <u>abetting</u> the crime
